title: Cix Currency
description: 💶 A currency system based on the Euro and other utility blocks
body:
This experimental mod adds a currency system based on the Euro.
Using the ATM block, players can perform various actions such as withdrawing and depositing money, as well as other banking operations.
All blocks, items, and GUIs have been entirely designed by hand using Paint.NET.
Everything can be crafted in Survival mode.

 # **Blocks :**
- ATM Machine
- Ticket Machine
- Turnstile
- Change Machine 
# **Items :**
- Banknotes( 5€, 10€, 20€, 50€, 100€, 500€)
- Cents( 1€, 2€)
- Credit Card
- Train Tickets
  
 
This mod is fully powered by Minecraft's scoreboard system, allowing for simple and flexible customization.

## The following scoreboards are used :

- **_cix_money_** – bank account balance.
- **_cix_account_** – bank account status:
> - ≠1 = no bank account
> - 1 = bank account created
- **_cix_pin_** – account PIN storage.

An example: /scoreboard players add @p cix_money 100
